description: This file is an init module for the qwen service, primarily managing module deprecation and re-importing components from submodules.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark the module as deprecated, redirecting attribute access to the actual module members

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedModuleProxy that prepares the proxy with the original module's globals, the module name, and deprecation message.
